nodes.label: Skill Daemon Contract
nodes.rationale: Six properties (idempotent start, exclusive pid-record claim, start-returns-ready, fail-closed start, SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL stop, local-read status) are what make the restart file a plain list of starts. Boot empties the records dir because a pid from the previous container can already belong to something else in the fresh pid space. whatsapp is the deliberate stop exception: SIGKILL mid history sync risks a device re-pair.

nodes.label: register-service Helper
nodes.rationale: Idempotent (same port per name); polls until vestad answers (REGISTER_SERVICE_WAIT) because vestad's API may still be coming up when the restart block runs; a start treats a failed registration as fatal because a daemon on a port vestad does not know about is worse than one that did not start.

nodes.label: service-key Helper
nodes.rationale: A service key is scoped to one service on one agent, stored only as a hash, expires in 30 days by default, and is revocable, so a consumer with no Vesta login can reach a private service without the app's api key. mint prints the secret alone because vestad shows it exactly once.

nodes.label: vestad-health Helper
nodes.rationale: vestad is HTTPS with a self-signed cert, so a hand-typed plain-http curl returns 000 unconditionally and mimics an outage; that misread cost a 9-hour phantom 'vestad down' on 2026-07-14. Always run the helper before concluding vestad is down.
